definitions.explanation: Pleasant or significant memories from the past, often with emotional attachment.

examples.japanese: {楽|たの}しい{思|おも}い{出|で}がたくさんある。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}の{思|おも}い{出|で}。
この{写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}ると{思|おも}い{出|で}がよみがえる。
examples.english: Looking at this photo brings back memories.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}い{出|で}になる (to become a memory)
- {思|おも}い{出|で}に{残|のこ}る (to remain in one's memory)
- {思|おも}い{出|で}を{作|つく}る (to make memories)

Related: {思|おも}い{出|だ}す (to remember, recall - verb)
